title: RegisterSession then SendRRData with deeper bounded CIP path
purpose: Exercise a slightly deeper unconnected explicit-message parser path after RegisterSession using a bounded CIP route shape that may elicit a normal path or service error without relying on truncation.

messages.label: SendRRData with bounded deeper CIP path

expected_behavior: Server should accept the encapsulation framing and CPF structure, then either route the CIP request or return a normal path/service error. No truncation, length mismatch, or parser overrun should occur.
constraints_preserved: SendRRData uses the documented common CPF item combination for unconnected data
Payload lengths and item lengths are internally consistent
CIP path remains bounded and even-byte aligned
Session handle field is a placeholder for negotiated runtime substitution
issue_safety_notes: This preserves a nearby explicit-message parsing context with increased path depth but avoids malformed or overlong segment constructions and does not reproduce any historical crashing path bytes.
